_readme: Bookie Tricks Exposed: short episodes on how gambling companies keep people hooked (shown in the Explore tab). Put a link in 'url' once a video is uploaded (or upload it in the admin area); until then the script is shown to read. 'duration' is what the list shows, e.g. "8:24". 'number' sets the order. PLACEHOLDER text until a psychologist has written and checked it.

episodes.title: The tricks explained
episodes.summary: How gambling companies design products and ads to keep you coming back.
points: Every product is built so the house comes out ahead over time.
Ads, offers and apps are tested to find what keeps people playing.
Knowing the tricks takes away some of their power.

episodes.title: How they hook you
episodes.summary: Bonus bets, push notifications and 'free' offers, and what they're really for.
points: 'Free' offers are there to get you betting again.
Notifications and emails are timed for when you're most likely to give in.
You can switch them off and unsubscribe today.

video.script: PLACEHOLDER: Episode 2 script: "How they hook you".

episodes.title: The illusion of control
episodes.summary: Why knowing a lot, or having a system, doesn't change how it works.
points: Lucky rituals and systems don't change random results.
Skill and knowledge feel like control, but the house still comes out ahead.
Noticing the feeling of control is the first step to questioning it.

video.script: PLACEHOLDER: Episode 3 script: "The illusion of control".

episodes.title: Why "just one" never works
episodes.summary: The thinking behind 'just one more' and how to step around it.
points: 'Just one' is usually the start, not the end.
Urges rise and fall: waiting is a real choice.
Having a plan for that moment makes it easier.
